Scoring and ranking of risks from measured signals, so the review starts with what matters most.

The concept behind it: [Risk assessment](@/glossary/risk-assessment.md).

Services that draw on it: [Corporate and counterparty due diligence](@/services/due-diligence.md), [M&A pre-deal screening and analysis](@/services/m-and-a.md), [Sanctions, PEP and beneficial-ownership screening](@/services/compliance-screening.md), [Insolvency, litigation and register change monitoring](@/services/continuous-monitoring.md) and [External attack surface and cyber-exposure assessment](@/services/attack-surface.md).

Practised with: [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md), [FastAPI](@/glossary/fastapi.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md), [GitHub Actions](@/glossary/github-actions.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md) and [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md).

It was applied in client work in Real-estate developer; the use cases below give the principle and the intent, without names or numbers.

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
